title: The Flow of Freedom
logline: When a massive flash flood turns her town's streets into treacherous rapids, a brilliant young engineer must use her custom-built wheelchair and quick thinking to save her friends from a blocked drainage canal.

beats.title: The Dawn Practice
beats.summary: Maya refines her wheelchair maneuvers on backyard ramps she engineered, demonstrating her athletic mastery and engineering skill.
beats.trait_in_play: reframe: her chair is engineered tech and she is the engineer

beats.title: The Transfer
beats.summary: Maya transfers out of her wheelchair onto the grass to stretch and build her strength during her daily training routine.

beats.title: Engineering the Chair
beats.summary: Maya transfers to her high workbench stool in the garage to work on her wheelchair and map out the town's drainage channels.

beats.title: Warning the Friends
beats.summary: Maya warns Leo and Chloe about the dangers of the drainage canal, predicting the flood's path three moves ahead.

beats.title: The Storm Preps
beats.summary: Maya and her mom prepare for the storm, using Maya's pre-planned safety measures and calm leadership.

beats.title: The Neighbor's Help
beats.summary: Maya firmly tells Mr. Davis not to touch her chair as she easily tackles a high curb that was designed without her in mind.
beats.trait_in_play: hates being helped without being asked

beats.title: The Flood Unleashed
beats.summary: The storm hits, turning the town's pathways into raging water channels and concrete ramps.
beats.trait_in_play: reframe: her chair is engineered tech and she is the engineer

beats.title: The Panic at the Canal
beats.summary: Leo and Chloe ignore her warning and get trapped on a crumbling ledge as the canal turns into a rapid river.

beats.title: The Rescue Mission
beats.summary: Maya rides down into the rushing canal water to save her friends, utilizing her secret summer training.

beats.title: The Trapped Caster
beats.summary: Maya's front caster gets tightly wedged in the heavy debris of the grate, leaving her stuck as the water rises.

beats.title: The Engineer's Solution
beats.summary: Instead of panicking, Maya uses her wrench totem to quickly unbolt the wedged caster from her wheelchair frame.
beats.trait_in_play: reframe: her chair is engineered tech and she is the engineer

beats.title: The Balancing Act
beats.summary: Free from the jam, Maya balances expertly on her rear wheels, navigating the rushing water to reach the manual release lever.

beats.title: The Lever Pull
beats.summary: Maya pulls the heavy lever, clearing the debris and draining the floodwaters just in time to save her friends.

beats.title: Rolling Home
beats.summary: As the sun emerges, Maya rolls home with her friends, proud of her engineered chair and her engineering mind.

trait_causality_note: Maya's mechanical planning and her specialized knowledge of her engineered wheelchair allow her to quickly unbolt her wedged caster and balance on two wheels to reach and pull the flood release lever, saving her friends.
